verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine. It hosts and serves models through APIs; it does not hold, browse, or analyze a user's business data in a product interface, so built-in AI insights on user data is the wrong axis for this kind of product. Its tool calling, structured outputs, and reasoning parsers are building blocks a developer could use to construct such a feature, not the feature itself, and the evidence shows no first-party insights capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
